title: Kokuangyō
body:
Syntax: perform kokuangyou <target>

Description: A darkness illusion that can blind the target.  Usable with any chakra nature. Base damage: 301-357. 75% chance to inflict blinded. The effect lasts 20 seconds before resistance. Unlocks at level 48. Costs 40 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
